_comment: Edit zones for non-Claude AI tools (D-071). Rules are checked in order; the first whose repo and glob match a changed path wins. Globs use fnmatch on repo-relative POSIX paths ('*' also matches '/'). red = Claude only: do not edit, log a request instead. yellow = may edit, the PR needs a Claude review before the user merges. green = free; still log it. scripts/check_zones.py reads this file; scripts/sync_claude.py renders it into AGENTS.md.

zones.red: Claude only. Do not edit. Write the request into your log entry (section 'For Claude') and stop.
zones.yellow: Allowed. Open the PR with the 'needs-claude-review' note; Claude runs the listed reviews before the user merges.
zones.green: Allowed. Log it; Claude may look at it later.
